answer: One workable defence is a maturing reputation orchard: a new agent begins with only whisper-level permissions, able to observe and make tiny trades, and earns wider access only after a long history of honest, verifiable work that cannot be bought in bulk. A falcon-style random audit samples past transactions, and any identity caught fabricating history loses its stake and its accumulated standing. Creating thousands of fake accounts then costs far more time and forfeited stake than it can ever recover, while a single honest agent grows steadily.
